title: Turn off SafeSearch on DuckDuckGo for good
question: How do I permanently turn off SafeSearch on DuckDuckGo?
answer: Pick Off in the Safe search menu above DuckDuckGo's results, or in duckduckgo.com/settings. DuckDuckGo keeps that choice in a cookie, so it goes back to Moderate when cookies are cleared, in private windows and on new browsers. The usermods script on this page adds kp=-2, DuckDuckGo's URL parameter for SafeSearch off, to every search that doesn't already set a level, so results come back unfiltered with no cookie. Without an extension, add &kp=-2 to the search URL your browser uses.
prompt: Always turn SafeSearch off on DuckDuckGo by adding kp=-2 to searches.
details: When you open a DuckDuckGo search whose address has no `kp` parameter, the script replaces the address with the same search plus `kp=-2` before the page draws. It does not touch searches that already carry `kp`, so choosing Strict or Moderate for one search still works. It changes no settings and stores nothing.

alternatives.title: DuckDuckGo's Safe search menu
alternatives.body: Choose **Off** in the **Safe search** menu above the results, or under **Safe Search** at duckduckgo.com/settings. It is saved in a cookie for that browser.

alternatives.title: A search engine URL with kp=-2
alternatives.body: Set your browser's search engine to `https://duckduckgo.com/?q=%s&kp=-2`. Searches from the address bar then have SafeSearch off. Searches typed on duckduckgo.com itself don't carry it.
